summary: Full-extraction pass over 16 stored documents: ten ÁKK (Hungarian debt agency) annual reports 2013-2022, two Maltese IIP regulator reports (2014, 2019-2020), the Latvian PMLP 2014 report, the UK HC 607 rules, an Austrian parliamentary answer and a Turkish written question. Added the settlement-bond appendix tables by series (EUR and HUF) for 2014-2021 and HUF totals, every statistical table in the Malta 2019-2020 report (applications, approvals, rejections, naturalisations, applicant profiles, properties by locality, values, stocks, contributions and their distribution, fees, donations, agents) and the 2014 application figures. Image charts in the Malta reports and the per-entity donation list remain to-dos.

observations.location: p. 1, paragraph beginning 'Bugün yabancılara usulsüz vatandaşlık' (repeated p. 2)
observations.quote: hayali satışlar dolayısıyla 451 yabancı uyruklu kişiye, 50 bin dolar karşılığında, aileleriyle birlikte 1198 usulsüz Türk vatandaşlığı
observations.notes: MP Murat Bakan's account of the Büyükçekmece Chief Prosecutor's investigation (sham property sales): 451 foreign nationals, who with their families make up the 1,198 irregular acquisitions already recorded. program_terms.applies_to: main applicant (own money), old 'investor' category (paras 224-229) before Tier 1
program_terms.quote: has money of his own under his control in the United Kingdom amounting to no less than £1 million
program_terms.notes: Predecessor 'investor' route deleted by HC 607 (Explanatory Memorandum para 7.28.2) and reprinted in Appendix F as the rules in force at 29 June 2008. Applicant had to intend to invest not less than GBP 750,000 in UK government bonds or share/loan capital of active UK trading companies (not property companies, not deposits) and make the UK his main home; leave to enter up to 2 years, extensions up to 3 years. The appendix does not give the date the category started.

events.title: 104 detained in operation against ring selling irregular citizenship
events.description: MP Murat Bakan reports an operation in the Büyükçekmece Chief Prosecutor's investigation (started on a CIMER tip-off): 104 people detained; sham property sales backed by inflated valuation reports gave 451 foreigners and their families 1,198 citizenships without the required foreign-currency inflow (USD 181.2m). The ring called the method 'BABATAK'.

Statement of Changes in Immigration Rules HC 607 (laid 9 June 2008, in force 30 June 2008) with Explanatory Memorandum: creates Tier 1 (Entrepreneur, Investor, Post-Study Work) and deletes the old routes. In scope: Tier 1 (Investor) rules (paras 245O-245U; Appendix A paras 42-50, Tables 7 and 8: GBP 1m own money or GBP 2m assets plus GBP 1m loan, GBP 750,000 invested within 3 months, 75 points, 3-year entry clearance, 2-year extension, settlement after 5 years) and the deleted pre-2008 'investor' rules reprinted in Appendix F (paras 224-229). Out of scope: Tier 1 General/Entrepreneur (GBP 200,000)/Post-Study Work, maintenance amounts, refusal grounds, deportation. No statistics.

Seventh annual report of the IIP Regulator (OR-GCES), covering 1 Jul 2019-31 Dec 2020, 78 pages. Section 1: regulator's activities: vetting of 340 concluded applications (207 approved, 101 refused, 32 withdrawn) and agent statistics; review requests; media and PQ monitoring (CCA investigation, birth certificates); court cases; Covid-19 impact; EU expert group. Section 2 (statistics, calendar years 2015-2020): applications received per year and month; main applicants by sex, region of origin and number of citizenships; dependants per year and by type; approvals (letters of approval in principle) and not-approved per year, month and region; rejection rate; naturalised main applicants per year, by region, employment, education and age; dependants naturalised; properties bought/leased per year and locality (Tables 21-23) and their value (Tables 24-25); Government stock investment (Table 26); contributions per year and period, distribution to NDSF, Consolidated Fund, agencies and Henley & Partners, funds in suspense; fees; donations to local entities (Table 28, Appendix B by entity); accredited agents by type (Table 29). Section 3: legal changes in 2020 (LN 161: NDSF share 70% to 20%; LN 235: deadline extensions; Act XXXVIII: IIP ended; LN 435-437 and 443: GCES, agents' licences, CMA, complaints fee EUR 5,000) and the regulator's past recommendations. Appendices: security clearance levels, donations by entity, operational guidelines. Out of scope: counts of parliamentary questions (18) and court sittings, staff matters.
